"Hold That Dragon"; Papa Dear is sent a dragon suit and an invitation to a costume ball; Before he arrives a real dragon goes to the ball and robs everyone; When Papa Dear, Mama Dear, Baby Snoots and Uptite Mouse arrive dressed up as a dragon Papa Dear and Mama Dear are thrown in jail while Baby Snoots and Uptite Mouse escape; They trick the dragon into going back to the castle where they put out his fire and Papa Dear and Mama Dear are let out of prison.

"That Swap"; Uptite Mouse finds out that his cousin Packy (a trade rat) left a bottle cap in trade for an antique watch; When he tries to return it because he doesn't think the trade is fair it turns out that the antique dealer loves Cousin Packy's stuff and trades him some valuable antiques.

"Wish Upon a Witch"; Baby Snoots wishes that he could fly so Wacky Witch gives him bat wings; He is then captured by a dog catcher who tries to sell him to the zoo.

"The Golden Dewdrops"; Baby and Uptite go into space when they get caught up in an old prospector's quest to recover the golden dewdrops he left behind on the second moon of Jupiter.

"The Terrible Tiger"; Uptite has a crush on a pretty animal tamer at the circus but then he has to recapture an escaped tiger.

"No Time for Napping"; The elephant family goes south for vacation, but Baby and Uptite get themselves in trouble because they don't want to observe the local custom of the siesta.

"His Royal Snootiness"; Baby Snoots's family goes to visit their royal relative, King Flab, but two crooks are out to steal the crown jewels at the same time.

"Toll for a Troll"; Uptite's ancestor has to outsmart a troll who has taken over a toll bridge.

"Back to Nature"; When Mama Dear blows all the fuses at home, Papa takes the family out to the forest to find dinner in the wild.

"The Rajah's Panther"; Papa receives a treasure map in the mail but it's a trick to distract a hungry panther so that Sneaky Dan can get the treasure for himself.

"Substitute Genie"; Uptite frees a genie from a bottle but the genie then traps Uptite in the bottle.

"Surprise Package"; The mailman mixes up two addresses and Baby Snoots receives the invisibility spray that Professor Sneaky badly wants.

"Jinxed Journey"; Baby does a good deed that results in his getting shipwrecked on a remote island with his dad and Uptite.

"Nutty Magic"; Baby and Uptite are captured by a man who wants them to be the official tasters for his peanut company.

"The Awful Ogre"; Uptite is transported into a book of fairy tales where he is enlisted by Puss-in-Boots to help trick a king.

"Super Dooper Snoopers"; Papa gets an offer to return to Mr. Biggs' circus when the elephant aerialist goes missing, but Baby and Uptite find the missing star before Papa has to go through with it.

"Forget-Me-Not"; Baby has a bad problem for an elephant - he keeps forgetting things.

"Cheese It.. A Mouse!"; Papa is swindled into renting a vacation home that's full of mice.

"The Welcome Pest"; Papa is tired of Uptite Mouse hanging around all the time and tries to get him to go away permanently.

Final issue !

This issue has the Hostess ad Tweety and Sylvester Gwanny's Wacation!.

"Wish Upon a Stone"; Snoots and Uptite get knocked on the head and dream they are in the time of knights and dragons.

"Twice Told Tales"; Papa Snoots finds a treasure map.

"Guest Who"; Baby Snoots lets a kitty in from the cold and Papa tries to get rid of Uptite.

"One Froggy Day"; Baby and Uptite believe that Wacky Witch has turned Papa into a frog.

"Meanie Genie"; Uptite and his cousin Packy find their uncle Sinbad trapped in a bottle and the three go after the genie who put him there.

"The Big Blow"; No one knows what to do about Baby's horrible trumpet playing.

"The Golden Elefink"; Two crooks take Papa Dear and Baby Snoots on an expedition to the lost city of Pachydermia.

"The Refuge"; Cousin Batty moves in with Uptite Mouse when his home is threatened with demolition.

"A Day at the Races"; Baby Snoots meets an alien kid and they go racing.

The fan-favorite DC Comics character burns his way back into the DCU in a startling new series by Dan Jolley, ChrisCross & John Dell! Teenager Jason Rusch has his hands full as a teenager dealing with an abusive dad and a local criminal for whom he unwisely agreed to do a job. But things are going to get a lot more complicated once he's granted the powers of Firestorm! Don't miss this hot new take on a classic character!    
 
Jason Rusch, a Detroit native and victim of child abuse, needs a job, and turns to local thug Stevie Golek. He is given a delivery assignment, and as he is delivering the package, a bolt of energy and fire smashes into him from the sky. After regaining consciousness Jason completes his delivery, late. He is caught in the middle of a gunfight, and panics; what results is that he and the nearest thug with whom he makes eye contact are engulfed in flame and light. What emerges is a new Firestorm.

After the events of IDENTITY CRISIS, everyone thought Ronnie Raymond, the original Firestorm, was lost forever. But energy can't be destroyed, right? If Ronnie has returned, he may be just in time to die again, at the hands of his old enemy Killer Frost!
With the threat of Killer Frost eliminated, Ronnie Raymond, the original Firestorm, joins current Firestorm Jason Rusch just in time for an attack by Multiplex and Typhoon!

With the original Firestorm alive in the mindscape, Jason is in the battle of his life against the augmented Multiplex and Typhoon! It all comes to a head as the mysterious villain who's pulled them all together is revealed!

"The Return of Ronnie Raymond" concludes as questions are answered and Firestorm's battle with some of his worst enemies comes to an explosive conclusion! But this deadly end only may open the door to an entirely new status quo for the Nuclear Wonder!

It's a new beginning for Jason Rusch as writer Stuart Moore (Lone) debuts! Inspired by his encounter with his predecessor, Firestorm is determined to make the most of his life as both Jason and Firestorm. That means a new job at S.T.A.R. Labs, a new apartment, and college. But two shadowy new threats may cut his plans short, and show just how powerful Firestorm really is!

"Secret Origins," Part 1 of 2! Firestorm's settling into his new life and job at S.T.A.R. Labs Detroit when a new villain crashes into town seeking revenge: The Pionic Man! What strange link does this new menace have to Firestorm, and can our hero defeat a man made of the primal forces of the universe?

The 2-part "Secret Origins" concludes as Firestorm merges with an unexpected partner in a desperate attempt to defeat the Pionic Man. Plus, exploding stars! Knitting needles! Mother substitutes! And a shock ending that takes Jason into VILLAINS UNITED!
A special VILLAINS UNITED tie-in! Trapped in a remote power installation by the Society, Firestorm, and a mysterious girl called Gehenna, must defeat Black Adam's army of supervillains to escape!

An OMAC PROJECT tie-in! Following the events of VILLAINS UNITED, a de-powered and weakened Firestorm seeks help at S.T.A.R. Labs San Francisco, which is under attack by a mysterious, unseen menace. Enter OMAC, its mission: kill the Nuclear Man!

Beginning the storyline that will send Firestorm into his next stage of evolution, as the INFINITE CRISIS hits full force! Merged with an unexpected partner, Jason (Firestorm) Rusch heads out into space with Donna Troy for a rendezvous with his cosmic destiny!!

The series bringing the Nuclear Man back to the DCU continues with Part 2 of the 3-part "Eye Contact"! All Hell's broken loose as 17-year-old Jason Rusch suddenly, mysteriously finds himself with the powers of Firestorm. But Jason doesn't have time to explore his new abilities, as real life comes crashing down on him in the form of Stevie Golek, the criminal Jason agreed to work for prior to gaining his powers. Now Jason's desperate to save his own life. But the price may be too terrible even to consider!    
 
Jason plays with his powers as the new Firestorm, learning more about the Firestorm matrix and the man with whom he bonded in the process. After he separates himself from the thug, the latter has no memory of his time as part of Firestorm. After pursuing Stevie Golek, he panics and merges with Stevie, who then attempts to manipulate Jason. Jason is forced to defend himself from Stevie's men, and inadvertently drops a building on them. Jason then watches helplessly as Stevie begins to dissolve within the matrix.

An INFINITE CRISIS tie-in! In deep space, Firestorm and guest star Animal Man follow Donna Troy's team to a rendezvous with cosmic destiny, and a deadly battle with an army of wingmen over a priceless Thanagarian artifact.

issue_title: Building a Better Firestorm, Book One: the Chalk Circle
description:
Beginning the epic that will redefine the Nuclear Man: "Building a Better Firestorm!" Following the catastrophic events of INFINITE CRISIS #4, a stunned Jason Rusch takes a fateful journey through Firestorm's past, present, and future!

Notes:

  • The cover is a homage to the cover of Baffling Mysteries #7.
  • The cover is a homage to the cover of Crisis on Infinite Earths #7.

issue_title: Building a Better Firestorm, Book Two: Lost and Found
description: "Building a Better Firestorm" concludes as Jason Rusch and a new partner must reconstruct the Nuclear Man, from the atoms up! But with the INFINITE CRISIS raging, can Firestorm rejoin Donna Troy's team in time, Guest-starring the DCU's newest hero: Jason's dad!
It's One Year Later...and Firestorm must stop a deadly nuclear accident and a threat to his very existence! And more importantly, just who was behind this "accident"?

Firestorm struggles to hold his life together, while Firehawk battles the ice-queen called Killer Frost! But what does Frost want, and who is her mysterious new partner? Plus, the mystery of the disappearance of Professor Stein deepens!

It's the Nuclear Man vs. Killer Frost and Mister Freeze in an epic battle that rages from the mean streets of New York City to the very heart of the sun! Plus, the return of an important person in Firestorm's life, and a surprise guest star!

Meet The Pupil, a twisted genius who's determined to learn all about Firestorm and Firehawk, by torturing Professor Martin Stein! Firestorm must battle his way through a bizarre army of cyborgs to rescue Stein, but is he already too late?

While Firehawk battles the psychotic Pupil and his army of cyborg Dollies, Jason Rusch searches frantically to learn the fate of Professor Stein, Jason's partner as Firestorm! Plus, more on the mysterious girl called Gehenna!

Beginning the biggest Firestorm storyline yet: the 4-part "In My Father's House!" Firestorm investigates his girlfriend Gehenna's mysterious past - and finds a new nuclear-powered menace - as his family life turns to chaos! Is it all connected? And who is the other Firestorm?

issue_title: In My Father's House, Part Two
description: The epic storyline "In My Father's House" continues as Firestorm, Firehawk and the mysterious glowing man face off against an army of cyborgs. But that's not the worst of it, as Jason Rusch must confront an even bigger problem: his father! Plus: a surprise villain returns!

The explosive first story arc, Eye Contact part 3 of 3, comes to a conclusion! Still struggling to understand the vast, incredible powers that have been thrust upon him, 17-year-old Jason Rusch finds himself trapped with his worst enemy, forced to face the harsh realities of his own past, and horrified at the terrible price that comes with being Firestorm, The Nuclear Man!

issue_title: In My Father's House, Part Three
description: Continuing "In My Father's House," the biggest Firestorm storyline ever! Professor Stein and the "other" Firestorm uncover information about the mystery villain that rocks Firehawk to her core! Meanwhile, an emotionally drained Jason Rusch pursues the enigmatic Gehenna to a fateful confrontation. It's all been building to this!

issue_title: In My Father's House, Part Four
description: The penultimate chapter of "In My Father's House!" The mystery villain's plan is revealed, and it's a plan that stretches throughout the DCU. But as Firestorm races against the clock to stop him, Firehawk holds a secret that may lead to nuclear armageddon!

issue_title: In My Father's House, Epilogue: What People Do
description: The epic story "In My Father's House" concludes as Jason Rusch must deal with the catastrophic fallout from his own actions against the mystery villain. It's an ending and a new beginning for DC's Nuclear Man!

The superstar creative team of Dwayne McDuffie (JUSTICE LEAGUE UNLIMITED, STATIC), Dan Jurgens (Superman, Captain America) and Ken Lashley (The Flash) bring Firestorm to bold new heights! Jason Rusch and Prof. Martin Stein just want to get their lives back to normal, but the New Gods have other plans! When Orion comes looking for Prof. Stein, you can bet a throwdown's not far behind! Guest-starring the Seven Soldiers' Mister Miracle!

Firestorm and the Seven Soldiers' Mister Miracle must defend themselves from Orion and the Female Furies! Everyone's after the secrets in Professor Stein's head, and that information will have dire effects on both Firestorm and the New Gods.
The end is here as Firestorm faces the fury of a superpowered Kalibak and a horde of Parademons! After this battle, you'll see a Firestorm that's never been seen before!

Jason Rusch struggles with living a normal life while simultaneously exploring his newfound abilities. But Jason soon realizes that becoming one of the most powerful people on the planet comes with a price, as he's visited by some very suspicious members of the JLA and accosted by an obsessed fan with metahuman powers of her own

Part 2 of "Everybody Wants You," guest-starring Superman and The Flash! Tortured with guilt following the discovery of a horrifying new facet of his power, Jason Rusch must accept that even Firestorm the Nuclear Man can't always survive on his own.

With the pressures of his family life and the gargantuan responsibilities of the powers of Firestorm weighing heavily on him, Jason Rusch finally decides to blow off some steam! But what will be the consequences of his recklessness…especially when the JLA reveals what happened to Ronnie Raymond?

Part 1 of a 2-part crossover with BLOODHOUND featuring guest art by Liam Sharp & Andy Lanning! Jason's past returns to haunt him when Stevie Golek's boss comes looking for answers. How will Jason's life be affected by this, and the vicious Travis Clevenger?

"Heroes" features the debut of new regular penciller Jamal Igle (Daredevil/Shi)! Jason Rusch faces turmoil from without and within, as his father gives him the harshest of ultimatums. But when Jason tries to help someone in need, he discovers that no good deed goes unpunished...

One of the original Firestorm's deadliest foes is back...in a big way! Can Jason and his accidental ally, Lorraine Reilly, survive the vicious onslaught, or will the villain's newly enhanced powers overwhelm them? Plus, an explosive final page surprise!

issue_title: Down Among The Dead Men, Part One
description:
Superstars Mark Millar & Terry Dodson team for SPIDER-MAN’s debut in an ongoing MARVEL KNIGHTS series. This action-packed, hyper-realistic tale finds Peter Parker forced to face the cruel realities that wearing the Spider-Man mask and web-shooters brings to his personal life. Featuring a brutal confrontation between Spider-Man and the Green Goblin!

During 'Down Among the Dead Men: Part One', after a punishing battle with the Green Goblin, someone tries to kidnap Aunt May, but can Peter Parker arrive in time to stop them?
Now that Spider-Man knows the identity of Aunt May¹s abductor, what¹s he gonna do about it? Think you know the answer? Guess again. Guest-starring Black Cat.

Things heat up as Spidey and the Black Cat face off against the might of the Sinister Twelve. HOLY COW, TRUE BELIEVERS! DID WE SAY TWELVE? Even with the tough-as-nails Black Cat by his side, how can the web-slinger possibly defeat twelve of the most powerful super-villains on the planet? You don’t want to miss this one, action fans!

Spider-man and Black-Cat are caught in an battle with the Green Goblin's new Sinister Twelve, and Mac Gargan aka the Scorpion has the venom symbiote and now is the new Venom. Plus a brainwashed Dr.Octopus is on the loose.

The pulse-pounding conclusion to Mark Millar and Terry Dodson’s run on Marvel Knights Spider-Man, featuring a showdown for the ages! Spider-Man versus two of his biggest – and most popular--foes…with MJ’s life at stake!  
 
Spider-Man finds out green goblin took aunt may.He also finds out that Mary Jane has been kidnapped.It also seems like deja vu were he's taking her.And wait till you find out were Aunt May is hidden.Spider-Man also finds help from his feline friend Black Cat.And just when Spider-Man and Black Cat are cornered Captain America shows up with the avengers.And Doctor Octopus tries to kill Goblin all in this 1 action packed comic.

Hollywood heavyweight Hudlin (HOUSE PARTY, BOOMERANG) has already brought you his searing vision for Black Panther. Now he’s teaming up with red-hot artist Billy Tan (X-23) to shake up everyone’s favorite web-slinger. In part one of "Wild Blue Yonder," Peter Parker’s life is turned upside down. He’s got an incredible new pad (you won’t believe where), a new job, and -- although he doesn’t know it -- a new nemesis who’s everything that Peter isn’t. But first, Spider-Man’s got to deal with a more pressing problem – a shape-shifting super-villain who’s developed a nasty habit…and will do anything to feed it. And Wait – Who’s that hitting on Mary Jane!?

In wild blue yonder part 1 Spider-man finds Mary Jane with Wolverine.He then gets into a fight with the mighty Absorbing Man an escapee that can transform into any substance he want's by touching it.On top of that Peter also gets fired from his summer job and has to go to J.Jonah Jameson from a full time job and also meets a familiar face.Owl also sets up a deal with absorbing man.A hit list.If he takes out those people in a limited time he gets narcotics to settle his drug habit.

The Daily Bugle’s got a new star reporter. Ethan Edwards is his name, and he’s the ace in J. Jonah Jamesons’ deck, the apple in Betty Brant’s eye, and the bane of Peter Parker’s existence! Peter may get the pic, but never before Ethan’s got the scoop. And if that weren’t enough, there may be even more to Ethan than meets the eye…Still, Spidey’s got more pressing problems to deal with: a shape-shifting super-villain who’ll do anything to feed his nasty habit.
Crusher Creel has developed a nasty habit and he'll do anything to feed it! Looks like a job for…Spider-Man. That is, unless a certain new hero on the scene doesn't get there first…
The neighborhood's got a new protector. He's bigger, strong and faster than Spidey and, even worse...he's hogging the front page of the Daily Bugle! What's everyone's favorite wall-crawler to do?
Ouch – that’s gotta hurt…When Spidey goes toe-to-toe with the mysterious new hero who’s taken a major bite out of the Big Apple, he’ll wish he didn’t.

The good news: Ethan Edwards finally knows who he really is, and where he’s from. The bad news: He can’t handle the truth. Is Ethan doomed to carry out the bloody legacy of his people? And if he is, can Spider-Man hope to stop him?

issue_title: The Other - Evolve Or Die, Part 2 of 12: Denial
description: Just another typical night of insanity for Mary Jane as she deals with an obsessed stalker and with watching helplessly while Spider-Man slugs it out with...Iron Man? And that' s just a warm-up for the devastating confrontation she has with Peter that results in the last thing she expected to hear.

issue_title: Down Among The Dead Men, Part 2
description:
With his secret identity exposed, a madman threatening to destroy his family and enemies at every turn, Spider-Man pays a visit to Earth’s Mightiest Heroes -- the Avengers -- for some assistance. But things don’t turn out quite like he expects…

After Aunt May's kidnapping, Peter realises that one of his enemies has discovered his secret identity, so persuades Mary Jane to go into hiding in an attempt to protect her. He visits Norman Osborn on Riker's Island in an attempt to discover the identity of the kidnapper, but fails to find any solid answers. He then seeks assistance from the Avengers, but is unwilling to reveal who they are supposed to be rescuing, thus revealing his own identity, so they are also unable to help. In an last-ditch effort to find answers, Peter goes to the Owl, who reveals that it was Electro and Vulture who kidnapped Aunt May. But can he be trusted?

issue_title: The Other - Evolve Or Die, Part 5 of 12: Retreat
description:
Overview

Having finally accepted his fate, Peter Parker decides to put the red and blue tights in the closet and spend some quality time with Aunt May and MJ. But Morlun's got other plans...

issue_title: The Other - Evolve Or Die, Part 8 of 12: Aftermath
description: "THE OTHER: EVOLVE OR DIE" PART 8 (OF 12) THE SPIDER-MAN CROSSOVER EVENT OF THE DECADE CONTINUES HERE! Beaten to the edge of death, hovering in a place short of heaven or hell, Spidey is about to embark on a journey unlike anything he's ever experienced. If he's going to have any hope to thwart Morlun's obscene mission, then he's got two choices: Evolve or die...

issue_title: The Other - Evolve Or Die, Part 11 of 12: Destiny's Child
description:
Overview

THE SPIDER-MAN CROSSOVER EVENT OF THE DECADE ENDS HERE!

The fourth and final month of “The Other,” a startling super-story spanning four months that has turned the wall-crawler’s world upside down, and set the stage for the year to come, uniting the creative talents behind all three Spider-Man titles! With great power must come great responsibility...but what comes with great understanding? In the past few months, Peter Parker has traveled to places he never has before. Now the question is, can he go home?

issue_title: Down Among The Dead Men, Part 3
description:
Peter Parker is forced to face the cruel realities that wearing a mask and web-shooters bring to his personal life in this action-packed, hyper-realistic tale by the superstar creative team of Mark Millar and Terry Dodson. Featuring a brutal confrontation with Electro!

Peter finds out from the Owl that Electro and Vulture have Aunt May. Then Peter gets into a fight with Electro and the Vulture. Peter winds up in the hospital and Mary Jane gets a gun.

issue_title: Down Among The Dead Men, Part 4
description:
As Spider-Man desperately navigates the seedy underworld of his most desperate and vile enemies, his missing family member is still nowhere to be found… The climax to this sold-out first arc features guest appearances by the Vulture, Black Cat, Electro, and The Owl… Get it fast, before they’re gone! 
 
The Vulture kidnaps Peter Parker from the hospital because he wants to see the face of Spider-Man's secret identity! The Vulture having no personal ties to Peter does not recognize him as anyone he should know, and the Vulture reckons that he has been beaten time and time again by a "nobody". He then just drops Pete and leaves him to become a smear on the sidewalk!

Enter The Black Cat! Felicia swings by just in time to catch pete and set him down on a rooftop! She then proceeds to fight the Vulture, ultimately managing to defeat and capture Adrian Toomes, and turns him over to the Owl, who has his men butcher and mangle Vulture's face, revealing the gory results to Electro in order to strike fear into him prior to torture over Max Dillon's role in the loss of Owl's money. Meanwhile as Peter recovers from gunshot wounds and his injuries from Vulture, J. Jonah Jameson receives photos of the unmasked web-slinger and says "That's a very familiar looking face"

Guest-artist Frank Cho (Liberty Meadows) comes on board to blow people’s minds, and to blow some things up for Spider-Man in a very unfriendly neighborhood! The brash, bold Mark Millar continues to beat the stuffing out of Peter Parker in new and inventive ways that you will not want to miss! Featuring Black Cat, Venom and Doctor Octopus! 
    
Eddie Brock is back in New York f. Also, after an battle with Electro and Vulture, Spider-man is still trying too find out who has kiddnapped Aunt May.  WHile thinking that, a brainwashed Dr.Octopus is attacking the streets of New York.  After Spidey easily defeated the savage doc ock, An group of swat teams try to unmasked Spider-Man for the reward for the unmasking of Spider-Man.
As Spider-Man continues to search for Aunt May, he pays a visit to a certain academy in Westchester and enlists the help of the world’s most famous team of mutants!

This month in the year’s hottest release: Things get worse! Everyone’s favorite symbiote is back – as only Millar and superstar Terry Dodson could envision him. Hold on to your spit, there’s a beatdown coming for at least one guy.
 
Eddie Brock has finally left the symbiote and auctions it for 1 million dollars and the buyer a thug called the fortunno he has high hopes for his son when the symbiote with open arms takes him to become venom.Angelo fortunno the host of venom crashes into peters and mary janes school reunion and kills an innocent bystander.Filled with rage spider man enages him in battle.

The thrilling conclusion of "VENOMOUS"! PART 4 (OF 4) Everyone’s favorite symbiote is back with a brand-new look! 
 
Spider-Man is battleing the new Venom.  Turns out that the new Venom is an kid named Angleo Fortunato,  who is an son of an mob boss named Don Fortunato who bought the suit for a million dollars.   Can Spidey beat this new threat?  Plus, in the end of the issue the guy who kiddnapped Aunt May calls Peter.

In this 4-part conclusion to the super-story, the identity of Aunt May’s abductor is finally revealed. But is that the villain who really pulls the strings? The roller-coaster ride that is MARVEL KNIGHTS SPIDER-MAN picks up speed, riding a corkscrew to its conclusion!

The guy who kiddnaped Aunt May has been revealed. It was Mac Gargan aka the Scorpion. He meets Spider-Man at an resturant a New York City. Gargan wants Spidey to break Osborn out of jail before he is sentenced too death or Aunt May will die. And the Scorpion confronts the venom symbiote at the end of the issue.

Andromeda and Lucien battle Voivodul, the evil Dayak sorcerer-god.

Lucien breaks through the very first part of this story, beating back the forces which is before him. Andromeda accompanies him and watches as he slashes and rips through flesh. It is a very short story giving some information on what is in store for the story arc.

Cover Price: Free

Format: Color; Standard Comic Issue; 16 pages

At the Chernobyl nuclear power plant, April 26, 1986, during the clean-up after the meltdown, the partial corpses of alien creatures are found. As the Russian troops begin to collect these bodies, several Blue/Black-skinned beings appear and demand the return of their PAGES. The Russian troops, with no idea what these strange beings are asking for, open fire. The beings disappear but are found dead nearby. The Russians set up a special laboratory to study these dead beings, believing that if they can discover the trick to this telepathy, they'll have a hand-up in the world.

PRESENT DAY:

Dr. Andromeda Weaver, an American scientist employed by the Russians currently in charge of this special lab and her personal guard, Lt. Lucien Barnes, discover a young woman with wings collapsed and near death, holding a strange roll of odd Papers... They take her back to Andy's lab,but when Lucien prepares to report their "find" to their handler, Vladimir Grigorieff, she strikes him in the head with a fire extinguisher, takes the strange winged girl, and flees, leaving the odd Papers behind.

Vladimir meets with Voivodul, after having council with Enoch, who grants him with an unbreakable bond and offers him total dominion over mankind in exchange for his help to regain power over the Dayaks and the Mineans.....

Also, previews the Making of Ascension 2

Andromeda is captured by the FBI while Lucien is still out there weakening to the death under the influence of Grigorieff who hold sway on him by the power of the Dayak pages. In the meantime, Grigorieff is getting way too close of getting his hands on the precious gem he needs to magnify his powers...

Andromeda finally cooperates with Senator Spencer who wants the help of Lucien to take Grigorieff down. But this one already got hold of the crystal he needed and has undertaken a mutation of Dayak warriors into furious beasts. In the meantime, the mysterious woman who plotted with Marcus against Petra is getting closer to achieving her goal of total power over Minea...

"Editorial Note: The events in this issue take place before Witchblade #27"
Lucien easily rip through Grigorieff's new mutated warriors, an ambush is set to teleport the fighting party down to New-York and Grigorieff is finally taken down by Petra.

Marcus has been promoted to the throne of Minea and he manages to convince the council to raise a ban against Petra who is now barred from her home world. In the meantime, the mysterious woman, Rowina, returns to Minea after an exile of a thousand years with a new grip on its people

Rowina is exercising her power over Lucien and Andromeda, forcing them to fight each other. What's more, she might be able to force Lucien to tear Petra to shreds with her mental suggestions. While they are stuck in a wasteland, Commander Salvati is getting data and info about Andromeda Weaver.

Rowina teaches Marcus how to exercise mental power over his enemies but Petra finds a way to utilize the visions to her advantage. In the meantime, Petra, Lucien and Andromeda have worked a deal with Commander Salvati which allows Andromeda to seek answers in pursuing her genetic research in a federal hidden laboratory.

Petra and Lucien are back at the destroyed Dayak citadel and are trying to find a way to get to Minea. Andromeda might have found a genetic relation linking Humans, Mineans and Dayaks which, if revealed, would shake the world as we know it and would lead it to extinction or ascension.

Why is Petra trying to create a schism between Lucien and Andromeda? The answer to that question will surely shock you, as the uneasy alliance Petra forged comes crashing down, and a new threat emerges who will mean nothing but TROUBLE!

In Minea, Marcus is coming to realize that the rule of Rowina has in fact enslaved him and the people he meant to rule while Petra has made a connection between the haunted dreams of Lucien and her late father Sophocles. Back on Earth, Andromeda and Salvati are just visited by a Dayak warrior on a motorcycle.

Can Lucien and Andromeda even hope to defeat this new entity that threatens their very lives? They'd better, because it seems that Petra is definitely out of the picture and this creature means business...

Petra's outwitted Rowina, discovering her secret vulnerability. Now Petra and Lucien escalate their brutal war of vengeance, taking the fight to Petra's Minean home by means she never dreamed possible. But if Petra's the daughter of the most powerful and manipulative entity in creation, what will she become if she follows through to the bloody end? Meanwhile, back on Earth, Andromeda unlocks scientific evidence that changes everything we know about humans--and our future ascension.

Lucien has been transformed by the pages he is carrying into a winged super-being. Under attack from the Dayaks, they are teleported into Petra's world to meet Lord Sophocles, leader of the Mineans. There, the origins of the ongoing war over the Pages is explained to the new visitors, something about a formula that was used thousands of years ago to banish a tyrannic Dayak ruler, Voivodul. The Pages is the one thing that could bring him back...

Andromeda and Lucien are held captive by the very government they once worked for. Now that THEY are the objects of study, how do they feel about the good old U.S.A? Plus, the Dayaks continue to seek refuge on Earth and a new villain enters the scene.

This issue was intended to be the final chapter of the series but was later picked by another creative team.

In the captivating conclusion to the "Resurrection" storyline, Lucien, Andromeda, and their new ally return to the ruins of the Dayak citadel in search of a cure to their condition, but discover that others are also looking for the same thing. Meanwhile, the Enemy casts a spell to ensure his invulnerability, with cataclysmic effects. Nothing will ever be the same again!

Andromeda and Hela find themselves trapped with no way out! And to make things worse, tensions between Andromeda and Hela continue to flare. Will they be able to settle their differences and find a way to escape? Or will they decide to go their separate ways? Plus, more light is shed on Voivodul's General!

Grigorieff, Lucien ambitious boss, has been chosen by the spirit of Voivodul to be is archangel in the fight to recover the Pages. Next, Petra is lured into a barren land where she is taken by Grigorieff for questioning. Andromeda and Lucien are soon after her...

Grigorieff challenges Lucien as he tries to liberate Petra from her torture. In the meantime, Agent Green meets Romanov trying to clarify the circumstances for the disappearing of Grigorieff, Lucien and Andromeda.
After defeating Lucien, Grigorieff takes hold of Andromeda's mind and through him, she is subdued by Voivodul who is secretely preparing a massive attack against the Mineans...

Harris is made prisoner when he is found trespassing without a warrant in highly sensitive area while the attack on the Mineans is launched. Andromeda, subdued by Voivodul kills Sophocles and nothing seems to be efficient in making her see the truth...

Lucien comes to terms with the choice he has to make: accept that the faith of this war depends on him alone. Meanwhile, Andromeda comes back with the last missing pages and Voivodul is finally resurrected after two thousand years of imprisonment. He will cast certain doom in the ongoing war, not only to the Mineans but also on his own people, thirsty to destroy all those who participated in his retirement long ago. There will be a showdown between Voivodul and Lucien...

The war has ended. Voivodul has been defeated by Lucien. There seems to be hope for both Mineans and Dayaks to reforge a peaceful union as Lord Enoch apologizes to Petra for not having seen Voivodul and Grigorieff treachery. In the meantime, Marcus seems to be pushing the council to take a vote for electing a new leader, therefore cheating Petra out of her birtright.
Andromeda, back in her own mind, is thriving to find herself, realizing how easily she had been seduced into doing another's will. In the citadel, Grigorieff, still devoted to Voivodul, is confronting Lord Enoch in a duel to the death. Only, the issue will not be the best for the blossoming new peace...

Boris Marcovitz closes the trap on Senator Spencer with a threat of Agent Harris signing a confession involving him in the investigation on the disappearing of Lucien and the whole business surrounding it. In the meantime, Lord Enoch has been defeated by Grigorieff and the humans Andromeda and Lucien have been banished from Menia after the murder of Sophocles. Thereafter, teleport back to the lab and then pay a visit to Romanov who spills the beans on where to find Harris. Only, they will find him dead...

In New-York City, Gavin Taylor is contacted by Grigorieff who seems to want to strike a deal with him about something. Then Lucien and Andromeda find out her parents are missing and that some federal agents want them dead big time. In the meantime, Petra is being drugged by Marcus who is planning to take over the throne of Minea with the help of a mysterious female being...
